name: Blade Bite
description: You engulf your weapon in destructive energy. As part of the action used to cast this spell, you must make a melee attack against one creature within the spell's range, otherwise the spell fails. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it takes 1d6 necrotic damage as the spell's energy rips into it. This spell's necrotic damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Booster Pulse
description: You boost the energy of a creature you touch. If that creature takes the Attack action on its next turn, it can make one additional weapon attack or attack roll as part of that action. If the creature is wielding a weapon that deals piercing damage, it can also push the target of that attack up to 10 feet away from it on a hit. If the additional attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d4 force damage. The spell's extra damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).
higherLevel: The spell's extra damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Dream of the Blue Veil
description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration and experience visions of another world on the Material Plane, such as Oerth, Toril, Krynn, or Eberron. If the spell reaches its full duration, the visions conclude with each of you encountering a guardian spirit, which takes the form of a majestic creature such as a dragon, a couatl, or a ki-rin. The spirit offers to transport you and your companions to the world you visited in the dreams. If you accept, you and the other creatures who accepted disappear and arrive in the dreamt-of world at the same location as the one where you cast the spell. If you reject the spirit's offer, you awaken and the spell ends without effect. Once the spell ends, you and the other affected creatures can't be affected by this spell again until you finish a long rest.

name: Druid Grove
description: You invoke the natural world to protect a natural area, such as a clearing in a forest or a hilltop. The area can be a hemisphere with a radius of up to 60 feet, or a 90-foot cube, depending on the terrain. The spell's area must be natural terrain or natural structures, such as trees, caves, or rock formations. The spell creates the following effects within the area. The entire warded area is under the effect of a pass without trace spell. A plant growth spell makes plants in the area dense and overgrown. In the area's interior, the spell creates the following additional effects: 1. At the area's center, a small shelter of trees and other plants forms, providing a comfortable resting place for up to eight Medium creatures. 2. Throughout the area, the spell creates a subtle ward against enchantment and illusion magic. Any creature that enters the area with hostile intent must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by you for the duration, treating you as a friendly acquaintance. This effect ends if the charmed creature takes damage or if you or your allies do anything harmful to it. 3. The spell creates a subtle ward against magical sensors and scrying attempts. The area is under the effect of a nondetection spell. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures who can pass into and out of the area without its effects.

name: Gravity Shift
description: You alter gravity around a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice. This spell ends if the target touches the ground or a solid surface. At 5th level, you can pull the target up to 15 feet. At 11th level, you can pull the target up to 20 feet. At 17th level, you can pull the target up to 25 feet.
higherLevel: At 5th level, you can pull the target up to 15 feet. At 11th level, you can pull the target up to 20 feet. At 17th level, you can pull the target up to 25 feet.

name: Intellect Fortress
description: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

name: Otherworldly Form
description: You draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or the Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself, gaining the following benefits for the duration: • Your eyes become pools of darkness, and you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet. • You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. • You gain resistance to either fire or necrotic damage (your choice). • Your weapons are imbued with otherworldly energy. When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 force damage. • You gain a +1 bonus to your spell save DC.

name: Power Word Pain
description: You speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, it is subject to crippling pain. Otherwise, the spell has no effect. While the target is affected by crippling pain, any speed it has can be no higher than 10 feet. The target also has disadvantage on all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks, other than Constitution saving throws. Finally, if the target tries to cast a spell, it must first make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, or the casting fails and the spell is wasted. The target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Psychic Scream
description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. Creatures that have an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected. Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned. If a target is killed by this damage, its head explodes, assuming it has one. A stunned target can make an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Pulse Wave
description: You release a wave of concussive energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d6 force damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from you and knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone. Unsecured objects that are not worn or caught are pushed up to 15 feet away from you. The spell's area is not blocked by total cover, but it is blocked by total opaque cover.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Sapping Sting
description: You sap the vitality of one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 necrotic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Spirit Shroud
description: You call spirits of the dead, which flit around you for the duration. The spells has no effect on Undead. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you. This extra damage is of a type determined by the type of spirit you call: radiant, necrotic, or cold (your choice). If the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, it must also succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. As a bonus action on your turn, you can increase the radius of the spirit shroud's area by 10 feet. The maximum radius is 30 feet.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 3rd.

name: Summon Aberration
description: You call forth an aberration spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the aberration Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a type of watcher, slicer, or slime. The creature resembles an aberration of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you issue none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description.

name: Time Slipp
description: You briefly slow the time around a willing creature you touch. The creature can use its reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. At 5th level, the creature can move up to 15 feet. At 11th level, the creature can move up to 20 feet. At 17th level, the creature can move up to 25 feet.

name: Touch of the Void
description: You touch a creature with void energy. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 cold damage and have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Void Writing
description: You can write on any surface, but the writing is visible only to creatures you specify. The writing appears on the surface as normal writing, but it is invisible to all other creatures. The writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic. The writing lasts for the duration, but it can be ended early by you as a bonus action. At 5th level, the writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and speaks a word that you designate when you cast the spell. At 11th level, the writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and speaks a word that you designate when you cast the spell, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and uses an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. At 17th level, the writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and speaks a word that you designate when you cast the spell, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and uses an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and uses an action to make a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
